## Authentication
Authorization Header — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (4)
- `DELETE /v2/sessions` — Delete user sessions.
- `GET /v2/ai/assistants/{assistantToken}` — Authenticate and retrieve an AI assistant.
- `GET /v2/ai/assistants/{assistantToken}/{assistantId}` — Get details of a specific AI assistant.
- `POST /v2/verify_two_factor_auth_code` — Verify a two-factor authentication code.

### Data Read (13)
- `GET /api/{apiId}` — Retrieve specific API data.
- `GET /api/v2/status.json` — Check the overall API status.
- `GET /v2/{v2Id}` — Retrieve specific V2 data.
- `GET /v2/ai/{aiId}` — Retrieve specific AI data.
- `GET /v2/ai/embeddings/buckets` — List AI embeddings buckets.
- `GET /v2/ai/integrations/connections` — List AI integration connections.
- `GET /v2/app_notifications/{app_notificationId}` — Retrieve a specific application notification.
- `GET /v2/kyc/status` — Check KYC verification status.
- `GET /v2/organizations/aggregate_category_permissions` — Get organization category permissions.
- `GET /v2/outbound_voice_profiles/{outbound_voice_profileId}` — Retrieve a specific outbound voice profile.
- `GET /v2/payment/auto_recharge_prefs` — Get auto-recharge preferences.
- `GET /v2/texml_applications/{texml_applicationId}` — Retrieve a specific TeXML application.
- `GET /v2/text-to-speech/voices` — List available text-to-speech voices.

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /{id}` — Create or update data.
- `POST /api/frontend/client/metrics` — Submit client metrics.
- `POST /mcp/messages/` — Send a message.

### Realtime (1)
- `GET /mcp/sse` — Subscribe to real-time updates.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Portal Telnyx's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Portal Telnyx data without official API access
- Automate actions on api.telnyx.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Portal Telnyx frontend uses

import { PortalTelnyxClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

// Load captured auth from auth.json
